_about: Names of cats and players are checked against these words after lowercasing, removing accents, undoing simple letter swaps (4→a, 3→e, 1→i, 0→o, 5→s, 7→t, @→a, $→s) and squeezing repeated letters. 'contains' words are blocked anywhere inside a name; 'words' only as a whole word, because they are short or appear inside innocent words. Italian and English. Edit freely.
